data.one_liner: Drop-in replacement for ExpansionTile with a Material Theme raised card look.
data.what_it_does: An extension on the standard Flutter ExpansionTile that renders a Google Material Theme inspired raised widget called ExpansionTileCard. It supports customizable elevation, colors, and animations.
use_when: You want an expansion tile styled as a raised Material card.
You need a drop-in replacement for the standard ExpansionTile with extra elevation and color options.
avoid_when: You require the exact default styling and behavior of the standard Flutter SDK ExpansionTile.
strengths: Customizable elevation, colors, and border animations
Includes methods to programmatically expand, collapse, and toggle
weaknesses: Limited to Material design raised card styling
